name: Phrase Recognition
description: Student sees an Indonesian phrase/idiom/expression and selects the correct English equivalent from a calibrated dropdown of 10 options. Auto-graded. Source: Vocabulary Vault (word_type IN Idiom, Proverb, Expression, Phrase).

name: Tell Me What You See (Visual Pronouns)
description: [DEPRECATED - Gunakan POINT_AND_SPEAK] [DEPRECATED - Gunakan POINT_AND_SPEAK] Student takes a live photo and speaks a description using correct demonstrative pronoun, to-be, article, adjectives, and noun.

name: Let me tell you something (Narrative Tense)
description: [DEPRECATED - Gunakan STORYTELLING] [DEPRECATED - Gunakan STORYTELLING] Student describes an event or tells a story in past/narrative tense.

name: Point & Speak!
description: Student takes a live photo and speaks a description using correct demonstrative pronoun, to-be, article, adjectives, and noun.

name: Storytelling
description: Highly flexible storytelling engine assessing student stories against configured constraints (duration, sentences, tense, pillars).

name: Read Aloud / Pronunciation
description: Student reads text aloud for pronunciation and fluency scoring.

name: Speaking Performance (5 Pillars)
description: Full speaking evaluation on 5 pillars (Fluency, Pronunciation, Vocab, Grammar, Comprehension).

name: Legacy Exam
description: Migrated legacy exams that have not been assigned to a specific AI module.

name: Pair Storytelling
description: Two students independently record story retelling sessions on their own devices. The system links them via a shared pair_session_id. Topics are auto-aggregated from previous Task IDs. Each student is evaluated individually (tense, duration, topic coverage), and results are shown as a combined pair report.
